lines.text: On the bus, not in the bus!
Many learners say: I am in the bus now.
Better: I am on the bus now.
For bus and train, say on.
On! She is on the train.

data.wrong: I am in the bus now.
data.right: I am on the bus now.
data.why: For bus and train, say on.

native.tip: En español “en el autobús”, pero en inglés se dice “on the bus” y “on the train.”
